items.title: Gucci Primavera is here: Jin, Ningning, Xiao Zhan, and more front Demna's new era
items.summary: Manila Bulletin's lifestyle desk covers the global unveiling of Demna's first Gucci campaign, Primavera, noting its heavy Asian-star casting (Jin, Ningning, Xiao Zhan, Lee Young Ae, Tarzzan) as a signal of the brand courting Asian consumer relevance, including the Philippine market.

items.title: Gucci Primavera: Visi Baharu Demna Tiba di Bangkok
items.summary: Malay-language regional fashion outlet reports on Gucci's Primavera collection activation in Bangkok, framing Demna's design direction reaching Southeast Asian retail floors and event circuits days after the Milan unveiling.

items.title: Thai stars TeeTee and Por announced for Gucci Primavera event at ICONSIAM
items.summary: Thai entertainment account announces that celebrity duo TeeTeePor (Wanpichit Twnpich and Suppakarn Jirachotikul) will attend Gucci's Primavera collection launch event at The Pinnacle, ICONSIAM, Bangkok on Sept 4, 2026, driving pre-event fan anticipation.

items.title: ICONSIAM posts TeeTeePor looks from Gucci Primavera launch event
items.summary: Official ICONSIAM account posts photos of TeeTee and Por's outfits from the Gucci Primavera collection launch at The Pinnacle Hall, using hashtag #GucciPrimaveraxTeeTeePor; part of mall's own promotional amplification of the brand event.

items.title: Fan community organizes engagement push for TeeTeePor x Gucci coverage
items.summary: Thai fan account compiles media coverage of the Gucci Primavera x TeeTeePor event and asks followers to like/repost/comment to boost visibility with media outlets, illustrating organized fandom amplification tactics around the brand tie-in.

items.title: Gucci's New Campaign Gets It: Asian Stars Rule Fashion Now
items.summary: Singapore/regional lifestyle outlet frames the Primavera campaign's heavy Asian-talent casting (five of ten global faces) as evidence that Asian celebrities are now default choices for major luxury campaigns rather than novelty additions, a shift relevant to SEA fan/consumer engagement.

items.source: Facebook (Gucci Philippines Buyers and Sellers group)
items.title: Gucci Philippines Buyers and Sellers community marketplace activity
items.summary: Active Philippine Facebook resale/buy-sell group for Gucci goods continues operating as a secondary-market venue; recurring community signal of price-conscious demand and preloved/resale interest in the Philippine market, distinct from official retail channel.
